description: A Cachet Vantage 900: matte graphite, seamless, taller than you and about as wide as a coffin laid flat. Sample bolts of fabric sit on motorised trays under a hairline of warm light, and the facade is machined so precisely no join shows. Cachet calls it a discretion suite, and won't say what for.
name: Cachet Vantage 900 cabinet
